method: pool all (fn,var) pairs; reassign var column at random (var degrees and fn degrees preserved, co-occurrence destroyed) and permute call-subject identity of HELPER/SELF_SIG vars; recompute top-30

transitive_control.method: permute subject identity only (direct sets fixed); stat = mean transitive-high over each run's own top-30

note: Direct blocked counts are degree counts: any var-degree-preserving shuffle leaves them unchanged, so the score-level control (falls{}) is INCONCLUSIVE for the direct part by construction and is reported, not gated. The call-graph contribution is what a shuffle can falsify: transitive_control.
